changes: A14: the first version never set LETTA_FS_SANDBOX=1, which letta-code 0.30.28 requires for the shell sandbox, and parsed LETTA_SANDBOX with a truncating regex. A14 is now decided by a run with the opt-in set; the default-configuration observation is kept in the detail.
D17: the first version never asked for tty:true. It now does, and requires the tool call to carry it.
A10 and A15: titles relabelled. They stay in the denominator as the direct-install variant; A10b and A15b are the registry-relevant results. No check was removed.
D18: no longer needs a model (checks session/new after the errors instead of a prompt). D01, D02, D18 and D19 now run in model-free scenarios so a chain whose turns hang still reports them.
